content: GitHub traffic badge implemented via shields.io dynamic JSON endpoint sourcing from gist (rdavydov/ad9a3c6a8d9c322f9a6b62781ea94a93/traffic.json); displays 'Views' count from JSON 'count' field. Badge system from MShawon/github-clone-count-badge. (source: TRAFFIC.md@306eb85, harvested 2026-07-23)
Merged changes deploy to production within 24 hours of merge (source: CONTRIBUTING.md@306eb85, harvested 2026-07-23)
Pre-commit hook available for Black formatting: pip install pre-commit && pre-commit install (source: CONTRIBUTING.md@306eb85, harvested 2026-07-23)

Discord logbook sends one persistent embed per channel; subsequent calls edit that same message to prevent feed flooding. Rich embeds include event-specific colors, icons, timestamps. (source: README.md@306eb85, harvested 2026-07-23)

Major AI-assisted features: Dry-Run Strategy Comparison, HISTORICAL Prediction Strategy, Discord Rich Embeds, Discord Mute System, Web Config Editor (source: AI_NOTICE.md@306eb85, harvested 2026-07-23)

Self-review checklist: address content plan, verify technical accuracy, follow template, grammar/style adherence, Liquid versioning, staging render, all checks pass (source: CONTRIBUTING.md@306eb85, harvested 2026-07-23)
Pull requests require 'Ready for review' template to be filled before review can proceed (source: CONTRIBUTING.md@306eb85, harvested 2026-07-23)
Issue labels used: bug, documentation, duplicate, enhancement, help-wanted, improvements, invalid, question, wontfix (source: CONTRIBUTING.md@306eb85, harvested 2026-07-23)
Code of Conduct enforcement contact: alex.tkd.alex@gmail.com (Contributor Covenant v1.4) (source: CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md@306eb85, harvested 2026-07-23)

Deployment: Python 3.12-slim-bookworm Docker base with HEALTHCHECK; export.py generates upstream-compatible run.py with graceful downgrade of fork-only strategies; CI uses self-hosted runners (source: IMPROVEMENTS.md@306eb85, harvested 2026-07-23)

Clone count badge depends on external gist at https://gist.githubusercontent.com/rdavydov/fed04b31a250ad522d9ea6547ce87f95/raw/clone.json; breakage risk if gist unavailable (source: CLONE.md@306eb85, harvested 2026-07-23)

Rate limiting: Shared RateLimiter class (token-bucket + exponential backoff+jitter) deployed across Discord, Telegram, Matrix, Pushover, Gotify; auto-backs off on HTTP 429 (source: IMPROVEMENTS.md@306eb85, harvested 2026-07-23)
WebSocket resilience: Backoff schedule [5, 10, 30, 60, 60, 60] seconds with jitter; reconnect counter carried across reconnects, reset on PONG (source: IMPROVEMENTS.md@306eb85, harvested 2026-07-23)
Python code formatted with Black (default settings) required; unformatted code rejected (source: CONTRIBUTING.md@306eb85, harvested 2026-07-23)
AI-generated code reviewed but NOT manually tested in every edge case or production scenario; gotcha for production deployments (source: AI_NOTICE.md@306eb85, harvested 2026-07-23)

Repository includes AI-generated commits by copilot-swe-agent[bot]; identifiable by author field and conventional commit format with Agent-Logs-Url in body (source: AI_NOTICE.md@306eb85, harvested 2026-07-23)
Input validation: _DANGEROUS_PATTERNS regex in AnalyticsServer blocks eval, exec, os.system, etc. (source: IMPROVEMENTS.md@306eb85, harvested 2026-07-23)

HISTORICAL strategy weighs historical outcome win rates (60%) with current odds (40%), falls back to SMART when no history available, requires enable_analytics=True configuration. (source: README.md@306eb85, harvested 2026-07-23)
Per-channel strategy switching: click any strategy in dry-run table to switch a specific channel to that strategy at runtime without restarting. (source: README.md@306eb85, harvested 2026-07-23)
